title: Monetary Policy Forecast Errors and Inflation Compensation under Sovereign Stress in Brazil
abstract: arXiv:2610.30487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper examines whether inflation compensation around Brazilian monetary policy decisions is associated differently with policy forecast errors when sovereign spreads are relatively elevated. Public Tesouro Direto quotations, meeting-specific Focus forecasts and a lagged EMBI indicator yield 68 three-year and 60 five-year event observations. The outcome is a matched-horizon retail yield proxy; the policy variable is the announced Selic target minus a preceding-week survey mean. At three years, a 10-basis-point forecast error is associated with 4.14 basis points less compensation repricing in the high-spread state than in the low-spread state, but the restricted wild cluster test gives a two-sided p-value of 0.1018. The estimated total high-state response is -0.42 basis points, with a pointwise 95 percent interval of [-2.25, 1.41]. translated_title: 巴西主权压力下的货币政策预测误差与通胀补偿
translated_abstract: 本文研究了当主权利差相对较高时，巴西货币政策决策前后的通胀补偿与政策预测误差之间的关联是否存在差异。利用公开的Tesouro Direto报价、针对每次央行会议的Focus预测以及滞后的EMBI指标，作者获得了68个三年期和60个五年期的事件观测值。结果变量为期限匹配的零售收益率代理变量；政策变量为公布的Selic目标利率减去前一周的调查均值。在三年期，10个基点的预测误差在高利差状态下对应的补偿重新定价比低利差状态下少4.14个基点，但受限wild cluster检验给出的双侧p值为0.1018。估计的高状态总响应为-0.42个基点，逐点95%置信区间为[-2.25, 1.41]。五年期交互项对疫情期间的会议较为敏感，剔除2020年后符号发生改变。
tldr: 该论文利用巴西国债收益率数据、央行会议层面的Focus预测和EMBI指标，发现在主权利差较高的时期，货币政策预测误差对通胀补偿的重新定价影响更弱，但这一状态依赖效应在统计上并不显著。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that monetary policy forecast errors are associated with weaker inflation compensation repricing when Brazilian sovereign spreads are elevated, though this state-dependent effect is not statistically significant.
